dedupe_keys.name: epa all hazards waste logistics tool

description: The All Hazards Waste Logistics Tool estimates the resources, cost and time needed to transport and dispose of large volumes of waste after a disaster. It was developed by the US Environmental Protection Agency's emergency response research programme and is released as an ArcGIS Pro toolset, first issued in May 2020. Users enter a quantity and type of waste, and the tool runs routing scenarios to user-defined destinations such as landfills and treatment facilities, taking into account factors specific to the waste type, hauling rates and facility acceptance rates, so that planners can compare options and find constraints before an incident. It is designed to work with the EPA Waste Storage and Staging Site Selection Tool, which proposes staging locations to include in the routing. Coverage is the United States, with any study area. The code is free and dedicated to the public domain under Creative Commons Zero, with a user's guide in the repository; it needs ArcGIS Pro, which is commercial. Caveats: results depend on the user's facility, rate and waste assumptions, and the tool gives planning estimates, not an operational plan. Simulation uses: debris and waste transport cost and time scenarios for emergency response and recovery planning. Related records: the Waste Storage and Staging Site Selection Tool (model-epa-waste-storage-staging-site-selection-tool), the EPA Disaster Debris Recovery Tool (data-epa-disaster-debris-recovery-tool) for facility locations, and the EPA All-Hazards Waste Management Planning Tool (platform-epa-all-hazards-waste-management-planning-tool).
